reason: Preference modes: more contrast and reduced transparency (specs 043-contrast-more and 044-reduced-transparency), cumulative since baseline 0.0.0 and superseding declaration 042-field-help-error (its deltas, and those of every declaration it supersedes, 041-token-deprecation and the one deliberate onmars value change of ki-button-quaternary-disabled among them, remain as declared there). The field help line of spec 042 now reads its ink through --ki-text-supporting, an alias of --ki-text-med-em, so its standard value is unchanged. (1) Both token stylesheets publish two modes as new contexts of the stylesheet surface: reduced-transparency/{light,dark}, active under prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce, prefers-contrast: more or the declarations data-ki-transparency="reduce" and data-ki-contrast="more" on the root or a theme root; and contrast-more/{light,dark}, active under prefers-contrast: more or data-ki-contrast="more". Each mode is a media-query block and a declaration rule after the stylesheet's own rule; the standard light and dark contexts keep every token value byte-identical to the base this declaration supersedes. (2) New public tokens: --ki-focus-ring-width, --ki-focus-ring-color and --ki-focus-ring-offset (the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws; the 13 component focus-ring tokens now alias them with unchanged values), --ki-tooltip-border-color (the tooltip edge, previously painted from --ki-outline-secondary-button-top in component CSS, same value), --ki-text-supporting (the role of enabled supporting text — labels, placeholders, secondary lines, quiet button labels, unselected tabs — which 46 component tokens across both themes now alias instead of --ki-text-med-em, same value, so more contrast strengthens it while disabled ink, which also draws from med-em, stays unchanged), and --ki-surface-{primary,info,success,warning,danger}-tint (content tints that alert, badge and the indeterminate checkbox now alias, with unchanged values, so reduced transparency can make them opaque while state washes keep their alpha). (3) ki-tooltip consumes --ki-tooltip-border-color, so its manifest, llms document and the Custom Elements Manifest regenerate. Purely additive: no token, member, prop, event, part or slot is removed or renamed and no existing effective value changes. The cumulative delta since 0.0.0 was already MAJOR. Nothing is published yet (0.0.0, private).
